lines.meet: I'm Orlando, mi amor, a witch doctor and a barber, which is basically the same job. Sit down, tell me everything, and let me fix that hair while you talk.
lines.meet_neighbour: Fenris Isle, mi amor! I've got a chair by the fire at the Shadowpine Altar, and you've walked past it twice. I'm Orlando, sit next time.
lines.ask_home: Tell me where you're from, mi amor, the whole story, I've got all day.
lines.ask_work: And what did you do before, {nene|nena}? Everybody tells the barber, so tell me.
lines.answer_home: Santurce, in San Juan, Puerto Rico. My papi fixed buses and my mami cooked at a school, and our house was full of aunts and cousins.
lines.answer_work: I cut hair for eleven years, in a two-chair shop with the radio always on. Everybody told me everything, and I never repeated one word.
lines.chat_food: My mami's arroz con gandules, mi amor, on a Sunday with the whole family. Forty people and one pot, and somehow enough for everybody.
lines.chat_sleep: I can't sleep in silence, it's terrible. I need somebody snoring, or a radio, or an aunt in the next room arguing.
lines.chat_missing: Salsa on the radio and a full shop on a Saturday, everybody talking at once. That's my idea of heaven, with love.
lines.chat_here: Wherever we stop, I make a little shop. A barber's a priest with better gossip, and everybody here needs a priest.
lines.tease_quiet: You're so quiet, {name}, mi amor! Everybody talks in my chair eventually, and you'll be no different.
lines.tease_talker: Finally, somebody who talks as much as I do! {name}, mi amor, we're opening a shop together.
lines.tease_careful: You'd want a trim of one millimetre, {name}, wouldn't you? With love, I'd do it, and I'd judge you.
lines.tease_bold: You'd cut your own hair in the dark with a knife, {name}. With love, it shows.
lines.tease_any: That haircut, {name}, mi amor, who did this to you? With love, it's a crime.
lines.tease_back: ¡Ay, {name}, that got me! With love, I deserved it.
lines.take_it_kindly: Okay, okay, {name}, you're right. My sister Yari says the same.
lines.bristle: Ay, not that, mi amor. Pick something else.
lines.apologise: Ay, perdón, mi amor, that was rude of me, and I'm never rude. I'm so sorry.
lines.double_down: With love, mi amor, I'm keeping it.
lines.needle_quiet: You sit there like a statue in my chair, and that's no good. Talk to me, please.
lines.needle_talker: Even I can't squeeze in with you, and that's never happened. Breathe, mi amor.
lines.needle_careful: You'd take an hour to choose a parting. Pick one, mi amor, with love.
lines.needle_bold: You run at everything and then you come to me with your hair on fire, every time.
lines.needle_any: You're rude to people, mi amor, and you don't even notice it. I notice it.
lines.bite_back: I've kept you all laughing through this, with love. Don't tell me I'm not helping.
lines.hurt: Ay, that went in, mi amor. I'll go and sharpen my scissors and calm down.
lines.laugh_off: Ha, I had a customer say worse with half a haircut, mi amor. Come on, with love.
lines.confide: {name}, there was a man, Gabriel, a nurse. He'd started leaving a toothbrush at my place, you know what that means. I think about that toothbrush more than I should.
lines.listen: I'm the barber, {name}, mi amor. Everything said in my chair stays in my chair.
lines.look_out: Close to me in there, {name}, mi amor. The spirits like you better when I'm near.
lines.accept: Okay, {name}, mi amor, your way. I'm a good listener too.
lines.deflect: Ay, a little scratch, {name}, nothing. Go and help somebody else, with love.
lines.check_in: Sit, {name}, sit, I want to see you properly. Tell me where it hurts, everything.
lines.blame: Rude and loud in there, somebody was, and the spirits didn't like it. You know who you are, with love.
lines.thank: Mi amor, I was gone, and now I'm not! Free haircuts for life, and I mean it.
lines.brush_off: Ay, it's nothing, it's the spirits doing the work. Sit and let me fix your hair while you rest.
lines.worry: Ay, {name}, mi amor, you scared me! Sit down, sit, and don't move.
lines.handed_down: Your gear looks fabulous on me, mi amor. It goes back to you whenever you want.
lines.hand_fine: Take it, mi amor, it suits you better. I've got my scissors and my mouth.
lines.hand_sulk: Ay, nobody even asked me, mi amor. With love, that's rude.
lines.turn_friendly: A regular now, {name}, mi amor. There's always a chair for you.
lines.turn_friends: You're family now, {name}, like my sister Yari. That means free haircuts and no secrets.
lines.turn_grating: We rub each other wrong, mi amor, and I get on with everybody. I'm hurt, but I'll still cut your hair.
lines.turn_rivals: The spirits heal everybody through me, mi amor, even you. No haircut, though.
lines.make_up: Ay, {name}, this is silly. Sit in my chair, and we'll talk it out.
lines.defend: Ay, no, that's not fair, mi amor. {name} was wonderful in there.
lines.friend_left: The chair's been empty since {name} went home. I keep looking at it.
lines.friend_back: {name}, mi amor, you're back! Sit, sit, your hair's a disaster.
lines.common_hosts: My shop was really the whole neighbourhood's living room. Anybody who's run a place where people sit and talk knows that's the best thing you can build.
lines.common_spanish: Ay, you speak español! Mi amor, finally, I can talk at my real speed.
